findings.description: The instance user-data contains an AWS access key ID and secret access key in plaintext. User data can be retrieved by principals with instance metadata access and is commonly retained in Terraform state or source control, exposing reusable cloud credentials.

TCP port 22 is open to 0.0.0.0/0, allowing any Internet host to attempt SSH authentication against the publicly addressed instance. This unnecessarily exposes a remote administration service to brute-force and exploit attempts.
The EBS volume does not set encrypted = true or a KMS key. Unless account-level default EBS encryption is enforced outside this configuration, data on this disk is stored unencrypted at rest.

This snapshot is created from an EBS volume that is not configured for encryption, so its backup data will likewise be unencrypted at rest unless external account defaults alter the source volume behavior.

The flow-log archive bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Sensitive network flow logs may therefore be stored without encryption at rest unless an external bucket default policy supplies it.
